1.0.0.en: Initial release. Local-network control of iSmartGate (PRO / LITE / MINI) and GogoGate2 garage doors. Real-time Open / Closed status, capability tile with Position toggle, automatic temperature and battery monitoring for wireless tilt sensors. Flow triggers for door opened, door closed, and door left open. Flow conditions for is open / is closed. Toggle action card.

1.0.1.en: Visual polish for App Store certification: redesigned app and driver icons in an outline / negative-space style for clearer recognition at small sizes, and added product photos for the hub and door driver images.

1.0.2.en: Icons reworked to meet App Store guideline 1.5: removed the solid background fill so the app and driver icons render as single-color silhouettes on a transparent background.

1.0.3.en: Added Gate support, including momentary pulse gates with no position sensor. New flow cards: opening / closing and status-changed triggers, a low-battery alarm for wireless sensors, and a gate pulse action. Fixed a polling crash that made GogoGate2 hubs show as unavailable. Fixed an error that prevented a second door from loading. Refreshed the garage-door store image on a white background.

1.0.4.en: Much more accurate door status while the door is moving: it now correctly shows Opening and Closing during travel, and the Opened / Closed flow triggers fire at the real moment the door finishes — no more firing too early or lagging behind. GogoGate2 is now a fully supported device, with updated hub naming and product image.

1.0.5.en: Fixed the app's own flow triggers (door/gate Opened, Closed, Left-open, Opening, Closing and Status-changed), which were not firing at all — any flow built on those cards now runs correctly, at the real moment the door finishes moving. This release also carries the accurate during-travel status and GogoGate2 support from the previous update.
